title: Mohd. Naeem v. State of U.P.
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J. and Rajiv Lochan Mehrotra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as withdrawn with liberty after obtaining documents.
headnote: A writ on electricity assessment was dismissed as withdrawn at counsel's request. The petitioner was directed first to obtain necessary documents from the Executive Engineer and, if still aggrieved, to avail remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Assessment was not decided on merits.
facts: Mohd. Naeem invoked the Allahabad High Court's writ jurisdiction against the State of Uttar Pradesh and electricity authorities in a dispute over assessment. After the Division Bench heard the matter, counsel sought permission to withdraw and to file a better writ on the assessment. The Court allowed withdrawal, directed the petitioner to obtain the necessary documents first from the concerned Executive Engineer, and recorded that if still aggrieved he may pursue the remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: assessment; withdrawal with liberty; statutory remedy
holding_units.holding: On the petitioner's request, the writ concerning assessment is dismissed as withdrawn. Before any further challenge, he is to obtain the necessary documents from the Executive Engineer; if still aggrieved, he may avail the remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The assessment is not examined on merits.
holding_units.flag: Order cites the 'U.P. Electricity Act 2003' (Electricity Act, 2003) and the Supply Code 2005 without a section or clause number.

not_decided.note: Writ withdrawn; assessment not examined on merits.
